about: A fast file manager that runs in the terminal.

prs.title: Moving a folder to another drive keeps its links and permissions
prs.broken: Moving a folder to another drive copies it and deletes the original. Links inside became full copies of what they pointed to, and private folders came out open to others.
prs.changed: I made the move keep links as links and give each folder its original permissions.
prs.matters: Moved folders arrive as they were, without bloat or loosened privacy.
